name: AI engineer 2: Real RAG and evals
blurb: Retrieval that holds up: chunking, embeddings, a vector store, BM25, hybrid search and reranking, measured with retrieval evals. Then calling real models safely, LLM-as-judge, eval suites in pytest and agent traces. Runs with Python on your computer. Every lesson shows the Python and maths it uses first, step by step.
